summary: Clinical Data Management and Good Clinical Practice training for trial teams. Learn ALCOA+, ICH E6, CDISC SDTM, and EDC workflows.
lede: Clinical data management training covers how trial data is documented, checked, reconciled, and prepared for review. It is for clinical research operations, data management, monitoring, quality, safety, and study oversight professionals who need to control data across study records and vendor feeds. You’ll practice source-to-CRF alignment, query and discrepancy tracking, safety-data reconciliation, and inspection-ready documentation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you work in clinical research operations, clinical data management, monitoring, quality assurance, safety, or study oversight and need to manage trial data against GCP expectations. Clinical Data Manager responsible for query control and reconciliation. Clinical Research Coordinator managing source notes and CRF completion. Clinical Research Associate overseeing monitoring, verification, and site follow-up. Study Manager coordinating timelines, vendors, and data deliverables. Clinical Trial Assistant supporting filing, tracking, and data issue logs. Clinical Quality Assurance Specialist reviewing GCP compliance and audit readiness. Data Management Lead governing edit checks and database lock readiness. Medical Coder handling MedDRA coding and clinical term consistency. Safety Associate reconciling SAE and adverse event records. Regulatory Affairs Specialist tracking inspection-ready documentation and data traceability.
modules: Clinical Data Management and ICH E6 Foundations
Clinical Data Quality Control and Safety Reconciliation
EDC, eSource, and Risk-Based Quality Management
Clinical Data Reporting and Study Oversight
prerequisites: You will need a laptop for workbook exercises and document review. A working knowledge of clinical trial documentation, GCP basics, and routine data review tasks is expected; participants should be comfortable reading CRFs, query logs, deviation records, and monitoring notes.
